resources.string:
Quest Claude starts everything itself: it turns on Wireless debugging, reconnects adb (quest up), installs tmux in Termux and starts Claude in a tmux session (default name: claude), shown live above the compose box.

One-time setup in Termux, if it isn't done yet:
1. echo "allow-external-apps=true" >> ~/.termux/termux.properties
2. termux-reload-settings

First time on a new headset, pair Ubuntu's adb with "quest pair" (see README).

"Open Claude" shows the same session in a full Termux window. Tapping "· remote" at the end of Claude's mode line runs /remote-control in the current tab, so you can drive that tab's Claude from claude.ai/code or the Claude app; tap it again in that tab to disconnect.
